label: Binary lift I
title: A four-reference binary lift family covers all 256 ECAs
summary: All 256 ECAs admit a faithful binary first floor in the completed four-reference census, at native radius 2. G remains incomplete.
takeaway: Four reference formulas cover every source rule; native faithfulness and commutator preservation remain separate gates.

label: Binary lift II
title: Every ECA has a faithful binary path through 3D; recursive G remains incomplete
summary: One reflection-aligned path per rule retains native evolution and source/parent recovery through 3D. Selected G passes 200/220; best-known alternatives cover 206.
takeaway: Finite-dimensional native closure is universal across the ECA sources tested; recursive G and induction remain open.

label: Binary lift III
title: A faithful encoding can lose G information in its field of changes
summary: All 36 first-floor G holdouts are diagnosed. Same-field probe ambiguity affects 2,432 faithful recipes; 29 rules remain blocked with phase labels among the originally faithful recipes tested.
takeaway: The field of changes must retain the distinction needed by G, and its demands must agree with native evolution.
